root_cause.text: Missing lower bound validation on `block_len` in `ncm_unwrap_ntb()` allows unsigned integer underflow when subtracting `ndp_size` or `dpe_size`, bypassing bounds checks and enabling out-of-bounds memory read via `skb_put_data()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a lower bound check `block_len < opts->nth_size + opts->ndp_size`; the CVE description and commit message explicitly state that without this check, `block_len - opts->ndp_size` underflows to a huge unsigned value, defeating the existing bounds checks and allowing a malicious USB host to cause adjacent kernel memory to be copied into the network skb.
